{{Infobox mousehat |name = Garbage Hat |image = Garbage Hat.png |source = [[Garbage Can]]s }} The '''Garbage Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained from checking [[Garbage Can|garbage cans]] in [[Pelican Town|town]]. It has a 0.2% chance to be found after opening at least 20 garbage cans. This can be increased by using the powers from the book [[The Alleyway Buffet]]. Upon obtaining the hat, an explosion sound plays, and the lid of the garbage can goes flying off. The garbage can remains without its lid for a short time afterwards.
